$comment: Public presentation of the realvirtual WEB editions (plan-646). Labels, groups, summaries and links live here; the licence tier and the beta status of a commercial row come ONLY from the private tier manifest, referenced through `ids`. Never add a tier here, and never add a restricted or internal registration (not even with public:false). Generate with `npm run features:generate`.

groups.label: Industrial interfaces (realvirtual CONNECT)
groups.note: * with a realvirtual CONNECT licence (annual or lifetime) or a licensed realvirtual site. Every tier supports every protocol.

rows.label: 3D viewer and HMI (GLB with rv_extras, panels, overlays, camera views, PDF links, machine information)
rows.summary: Opens realvirtual GLB models in the browser and adds operator panels, overlays, camera views and documents linked to machine parts.

rows.label: WebXR (VR/AR in the browser)
rows.summary: Shows the twin in VR and AR on browsers and devices that support WebXR.

rows.label: Cinematic rendering and video recording
rows.summary: Renders path-traced frames and records videos of the running twin.

rows.label: Virtual camera displays
rows.summary: Shows the live image of a camera placed in the scene on a display in the twin.

rows.label: Stereo 3D
rows.summary: Shows the twin in side-by-side stereo on a compatible 3D display.

rows.label: Display walls
rows.summary: Renders calibrated views for LED walls and projectors with optional head tracking.

rows.label: Flystick control
rows.summary: Uses an ART Flystick to point, select, move parts and navigate at a display wall.

rows.label: Ray-traced render mode
rows.summary: Lights the live twin with WebGPU ray tracing: bounced light, reflections, transparency and soft shadows.

rows.label: Guided maintenance (the machine follows the steps)
rows.summary: Animates the machine through a step-by-step maintenance guide: doors open, housings turn transparent, coolant sprays, parts unscrew, and every step can be replayed backwards.

rows.label: Transport simulation (drives, sensors, conveyors, sources/sinks, grippers, LogicSteps)
rows.summary: Simulates material flow in the browser at a fixed time step with drives, sensors, conveyors, sources, sinks, grippers and LogicStep sequences.

rows.label: Collision detection
rows.summary: Checks bodies with different collision roles against each other while the simulation runs.

rows.label: Smooth drive motion
rows.summary: Moves drives along jerk-limited motion profiles.

rows.label: Motion trail (swept volume)
rows.summary: Visualizes the swept volume of moving parts during simulation.

rows.label: Physics
rows.summary: Simulates parts with rigid-body physics.

rows.label: Detail physics (MuJoCo)
rows.summary: Simulates contact, friction and force-limited axes in detail: a gripper that holds by contact and can slip, a part that jams in a fixture, a free body that gets shoved out of place.

rows.label: Discrete event simulation
rows.summary: Runs event-driven material flow simulations much faster than real time, with statistics, snapshots and scripts. The experiment manager (variants, repeated runs, run comparison) is Commercial.

rows.label: DES experiment manager
rows.summary: Compares variants with replication matrices, batch runs, confidence intervals and experiment export/import.

rows.label: Machining simulation
rows.summary: Simulates material removal on a workpiece.

rows.label: Virtual PLC (Structured Text in the browser)
rows.summary: Programs and runs Structured Text PLC logic directly in the browser.

rows.label: Layout planner
rows.summary: Assembles factory layouts in the browser from library parts connected by snap points.

rows.label: Asset and kinematics editor
rows.summary: Groups parts, assigns materials, creates drives and saves the result as a GLB in the browser.

rows.label: CAD import (STEP, JT, USD, FBX, Onshape, Unity Asset Manager)
rows.summary: Imports CAD data from common formats and sources into the editor.

rows.label: Robot inverse kinematics
rows.summary: Solves the joint positions of a robot for a target pose.

rows.label: Kinematic mechanisms (cranks, couplers, parallel kinematics)
rows.summary: Solves closed-loop mechanisms such as cranks, couplers and parallel kinematics.

rows.label: Signals and PLC connectivity (WebSocket, MQTT, ctrlX, REST; drag-and-drop signal linking)
rows.summary: Connects the twin to live PLC signals over WebSocket, MQTT, ctrlX and REST, with drag-and-drop signal linking.

rows.label: Multiuser sessions
rows.summary: Lets several people work in one twin at the same time with avatars and shared views.

rows.label: Siemens (S7, PLCSIM Advanced)
rows.summary: Couples S7-300/400/1200/1500 controllers over S7comm and PLCSIM Advanced instances through the native Siemens simulation API.

rows.label: OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP (client and server)
rows.summary: Connects to any OPC UA server, to MQTT brokers (single values, Siemens process images), to SEW MOVI-C over MQTT JSON or UDP and to Modbus TCP devices, or acts as a Modbus TCP server for a PLC or SCADA system.

rows.label: Controllers (Beckhoff TwinCAT ADS, EtherNet/IP for Allen-Bradley and Omron, B&R PVI, Mitsubishi MELSEC, Keba, Festo AX / PLCnext, Bosch Rexroth ctrlX)
rows.summary: Reads and writes controller variables by symbol, tag or address; most controllers can be browsed, so signals are selected rather than typed.

rows.label: Robots (FANUC, KUKA, ABB, Universal Robots, Denso, igus, RoboDK, Wandelbots NOVA)
rows.summary: Couples robot controllers and their virtual controllers (RoboGuide, OfficeLite, iiQKA/RSI, RobotStudio, URSim, WinCaps VRC) for IOs and joint positions.

rows.label: Simulation and custom couplings (SIMIT, WINMOD, shared memory, UDP telegrams, WebSocket Realtime)
rows.summary: Couples simulation tools on the same PC through shared memory, exchanges fixed binary UDP telegrams, and links realvirtual for Unity or another CONNECT over WebSocket.

rows.label: CAD conversion (STEP, JT)
rows.summary: Converts large STEP and JT files to GLB on the gateway, for the CAD import of the asset editor.

cells.community: Not included (CAD import is part of the editor)
cells.demo: Free tier: 25 MB STEP / 12 MB JT

rows.label: Plugin system and MCP bridge for AI assistants
rows.summary: Extends the viewer with plugins and lets AI assistants inspect and operate the twin through MCP.

rows.label: USD live link to NVIDIA Isaac Sim (incl. Kit extension)
rows.summary: Mirrors the running twin live into NVIDIA Isaac Sim through a Kit extension.

rows.label: USD export
rows.summary: Exports the twin as USD including its realvirtual component data.

rows.label: USD animation recording
rows.summary: Records the running simulation as an animated USD file, live or for a set duration in deterministic mode.

rows.label: AI prompt window (Claude Code CLI)
rows.summary: Runs the local Claude Code CLI from a prompt window in the viewer.

rows.label: Internal tools (diagnostics, feature matrix, share decryption, SolidCraft sync)
rows.summary: Supporting infrastructure that is counted as commercial but not presented as a feature.
